hypothesis: The OB Liquidity Reversal setup (user's DOOD example) was rejected on the 8-12 largest markets (S112/S113). It may still work on smaller altcoins, where it was observed. This is a new population: none of these symbols were used by S112/S113.
rules: Detector rules exactly as committed for S112/S113 (l1_filter/ob_liquidity_reversal.py); no parameter changes.

universe.source: every USDT-margined symbol with a Binance USD-M monthly kline archive (data.binance.vision bucket listing), including later-delisted symbols
universe.selection_date: 2025-05-01T00:00:00Z, using only data before that date
universe.exclusions: BTC, ETH, stablecoins, gold/index tokens, and the 12 S113 symbols (BTC ETH BNB SOL XRP ADA DOGE AVAX LINK LTC BCH DOT)
universe.eligibility: daily klines exist for 2025-03-17 or earlier (>= 45 days of history at selection)
universe.fixed_thereafter: no symbol is added later; symbols delisted later stay in and are simulated until their data ends (open positions closed at their last price)

data.missing_data: a symbol whose minute data cannot be made continuous from checksumed monthly+daily archives is reported as excluded with the reason

routes.STRICT: nearest 1h BSL target, trade only if stress net R >= 3 (literal user rule)
routes.EXTERNAL: first 1h BSL with stress net R in [3, 10]
routes.ABSORB_CVD: EXTERNAL + CVD-divergence absorption + 4h discount (open-interest flush not used: metrics archives not loaded for 48 symbols)

execution: each symbol simulated as a standalone $250 account at 0.2% risk (one position, one pending limit); results aggregated in R per trade, so capacity/portfolio effects are excluded by design
multiple_testing: Three routes; each must pass on its own.
after_pass: Shadow/paper on the same broad universe via setup search journal; no live approval.
disclosure: Retrospective; all three windows are new for these symbols, but the rule family was designed after S112/S113 diagnostics on other markets.
